command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write logrotate config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app > /dev/null <<'EOF'
/var/log/inventory/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}
EOF
cat /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app

echo "== STEP 2: validate config syntax =="
sudo -n logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1

echo "== STEP 3: capture baseline app.log inode/content =="
stat -c '%i %s' /var/log/inventory/app.log
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log

echo "== STEP 4: force a rotation to prove behavior =="
sudo -n logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app -s /tmp/logrotate-inventory.status 2>&1

echo "== STEP 5: verify rotation results =="
ls -la /var/log/inventory/
echo "-- app.log still same inode (copytruncate keeps file) --"
stat -c '%i %s' /var/log/inventory/app.log
echo "-- rotated compressed file present --"
ls /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz 2>/dev/null && zcat /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz

echo "== STEP 6: simulate app continuing to write after rotation =="
echo "post-rotation write test $(date -Iseconds)" | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory/app.log > /dev/null
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log

echo "== STEP 7: run once more to test rotate-count retention logic (simulate multiple days) =="
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  echo "day$i entry" | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory/app.log > /dev/null
  sudo -n logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app -s /tmp/logrotate-inventory.status 2>&1 >/dev/null
done
ls -la /var/log/inventory/
